([[Canberra, Australian Capital Territory]]) | college = [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas]] (2023–2024) | highlights = * [[Big 12 Conference|Big 12]] All-Freshman team (2024) }} '''Johnny Furphy''' (born 7 December 2004) is an Australian [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas Jayhawks]]. ==Early life== Furphy was born and grew up in [[Melbourne]], [[Australia]].{{cite web|url=https://www.cjonline.com/story/sports/college/hawk-zone/2023/12/19/kansas-basketball-freshman-guard-johnny-furphy-will-miss-yale-game/71969994007/|title=Kansas basketball freshman guard Johnny Furphy will miss Yale game|work=[[The Topeka Capital-Journal]]|date=19 December 2023|access-date=14 February 2024}} He was awarded a sport scholarship to Maribyrnong Sports Academy{{Cite news |last=Sarris |first=Melina |date=24/06/2024 |title=Melbourne teenager Johnny Furphy is on the verge of basketball superstardom. The 19-year-old is set to be selected in this week's NBA draft making him an instant multimillionaire |url=https://x.com/7NewsMelbourne/status/1805159426510467224 |url-status=live}} where he was coached by [[Shane McDonald]]. Johnny completed his academic studies at [[Maribyrnong College]], graduating in 2022{{Cite web |date=2024-06-22 |title=MSA Alumnus Johnny Furphy invited to Green Room for NBA draft |url=https://sportsacademy.maribsc.vic.edu.au/news-and-media/2024/6/22/msa-alumnus-johnny-furphy-invited-to-green-room-for-nba-draft |access-date=2024-06-24 |website=MSA - Maribyrnong Sports Academy |language=en-US}}. Furphy attended the [[Basketball Australia]] Centre for Excellence (CoE) at the [[Australian Institute of Sport]].{{cite web|url=https://www.kansascity.com/sports/college/big-12/university-of-kansas/article278152827.html|title=New KU basketball small forward Johnny Furphy working out with NBL team in Australia|work=[[The Kansas City Star]]|date=11 August 2023|access-date=14 February 2024}} Furphy averaged 14.3 points and 5.6 rebounds in 12 games during his final season at CoE.{{cite web|url=https://theathletic.com/4747935/2023/08/03/kansas-johnny-furphy/|title=Kansas signs 2023 small forward Johnny Furphy: How the Australian became a Jayhawk|first=Sam|last=Vecenie|website=[[The Athletic]]|date=3 August 2023|access-date=20 February 2024}} He committed to playing college basketball in the United States for [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas]].{{cite web|url=https://www.kansascity.com/sports/college/big-12/university-of-kansas/article277975208.html|title=New KU basketball signee Johnny Furphy will 'positively' be in the rotation, Self says|work=[[The Kansas City Star]]|date=4 August 2023|access-date=14 February 2024}} ==College career== Furphy entered his freshman season at Kansas as a key reserve [[Wing (basketball)|wing]].{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/kansas/article/johnny-furphy-kansas-basketball-role-222344580/|title=Johnny Furphy embracing his role off the bench for KU basketball|first=Michael|last=Swan|website=[[247Sports]]|date=4 December 2023|access-date=20 February 2024}} He made his first college start on 13 January 2024, against ninth-ranked [[2023–24 Oklahoma Sooners men's basketball team|Oklahoma]] and scored seven points in a 78–66 win.{{cite web|url=https://www.sportingnews.com/us/nba/news/johnny-furphy-australian-ncaa-player-kansas-jayhawks/33d176c97f18b26e4c82fbfc|title=Who is Johnny Furphy? Australian NCAA-player starring for Kansas Jayhawks|first=Jed|last=Wells|website=[[Sporting News]]|date=7 February 2024|access-date=20 February 2024}} Furphy was named to the [[Big 12 Conference]] All-Freshman team at the end of the regular season.{{cite web|url=https://www.dodgeglobe.com/kansas-well-represented-on-all-big-12-team/|title=Kansas Well Represented on All-Big 12 Team|work=[[Dodge City Daily Globe]]|date=14 March 2024|access-date=20 March 2024}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===College=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2023–24]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2023–24 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas]] | 33 || 19 || 24.1 || .466 || .352 || .765 || 4.9 || 1.0 || .9 || .3 || 9.0 {{S-end}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://kuathletics.com/roster/johnny-furphy/ Kansas Jayhawks bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Furphy, Johnny}} [[Category:2004 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Australian expatriate basketball people in the United States]] [[Category:Australian men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Melbourne]] [[Category:Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball players]] [[Category:Shooting guards]] [[Category:Small forwards]]
